title: Novena to St. Therese (Little Flower)
description: A nine-day prayer to St. Therese of Lisieux, known for her 'Little Way' of spiritual childhood, complete trust in God, and her promise to 'spend my heaven doing good on earth.' Famous for sending roses as signs of answered prayers.
intention: For simple trust in God, spiritual growth through small acts of love, healing of families, and for receiving 'roses' (signs) of God's love
instructions: Pray this novena for 9 consecutive days with the simple trust of a child. St. Therese promised to 'let fall a shower of roses' from heaven, and many people receive roses or the scent of roses as signs that their prayers are heard. Her 'Little Way' teaches us that small acts of love done with great faith are pleasing to God. Include your personal intentions while asking to grow in her spirit of trust and simplicity.
background_info: St. Therese of Lisieux (1873-1897) was a French Carmelite nun who died at only 24 but became one of the most beloved saints. She developed the 'Little Way' of spiritual childhood, emphasizing trust, simplicity, and doing small things with great love. She promised before her death to 'spend my heaven doing good on earth' and to 'let fall a shower of roses.' She was declared a Doctor of the Church in 1997, making her the youngest Doctor. Her autobiography, 'Story of a Soul,' has inspired millions.

days.title: Day 1: The Little Way of Trust
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: Dear Little Flower, St. Therese of the Child Jesus, you discovered the Little Way of spiritual childhood and taught us that we can reach great holiness through simple trust and love. You understood that God loves us not because we are great, but because we are small, and that His mercy is greater than all our weaknesses. I come to you today asking you to teach me your Little Way. Help me to approach God with the trust of a small child who knows that their loving Father will take care of everything. When I am tempted to rely too much on my own strength or to worry about my inadequacies, remind me that God's power is made perfect in weakness. Help me to surrender my need to be in control and to rest securely in God's loving care. Show me how to do small things with great love, knowing that even the smallest acts of kindness and sacrifice can become pathways to holiness when offered with a pure heart. St. Therese, teach me to trust as you trusted, to love as you loved, and to abandon myself completely to God's will. Amen.
days.closing_prayer: St. Therese, Little Flower of Jesus, pray for us.
days.reflection: St. Therese's Little Way is revolutionary because it shows that sanctity is accessible to everyone. We don't need to perform great deeds - we need only to trust completely in God's love and to do ordinary things with extraordinary love.
days.intention_prayer: St. Therese, help me to embrace your Little Way. Teach me to trust God like a child and to find holiness in the simple moments of daily life.
days.scripture: "Truly I tell you, unless you change and become like little children, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven." - Matthew 18:3

days.title: Day 2: Confidence Despite Weakness
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: St. Therese, you wrote that you would never be discouraged by your faults because you understood that God's mercy is infinite. You knew that your weaknesses were not obstacles to holiness but opportunities for God's grace to work more powerfully in your life. I often become discouraged when I fail, when I sin, or when I don't live up to my own expectations. Help me to see my weaknesses as you did - not as barriers to God's love but as invitations to trust more deeply in His mercy. When I fall, help me to get up quickly without spending time in useless self-reproach. Teach me to run to God like a child runs to their parent when they are hurt, confident that I will find comfort and healing. Help me to understand that God is not shocked by my sins or disappointed by my failures because He already knows everything about me and loves me completely. Give me the confidence to believe that God can use even my mistakes and weaknesses for good when I offer them to Him with trust. St. Therese, help me to have your unshakeable confidence in God's love. Amen.
days.closing_prayer: St. Therese, Little Flower of Jesus, pray for us.
days.reflection: St. Therese's confidence was not based on her own strength but on God's infinite mercy. She teaches us that our weaknesses can actually become sources of spiritual strength when they lead us to rely more completely on God.
days.intention_prayer: St. Therese, help me to be confident in God's love despite my weaknesses. Teach me to trust in His mercy rather than in my own perfection.
days.scripture: "But he said to me, 'My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.'" - 2 Corinthians 12:9

days.title: Day 3: Love in Small Things
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: St. Therese, you understood that love is shown not in great deeds but in the way we do ordinary things. You found opportunities for love and sacrifice in the simple daily routines of convent life - in being patient with difficult people, in performing humble tasks with joy, in offering small acts of kindness without being noticed. Help me to see my daily life as you saw yours - as countless opportunities to show love for God and neighbor. Teach me to find God in the mundane moments: in washing dishes, in listening patiently to others, in doing my work well, in being gentle with those who annoy me. Help me to understand that no act of love is too small to matter to God. When I am tempted to think that my life is insignificant or that I cannot make a difference, remind me that Mother Teresa said we cannot do great things, only small things with great love. Show me how to transform ordinary moments into prayers and how to offer even my smallest actions as gifts to God. St. Therese, help me to love greatly in little ways. Amen.
days.closing_prayer: St. Therese, Little Flower of Jesus, pray for us.
days.reflection: St. Therese discovered that holiness is not about the size of our actions but about the love with which we perform them. Her Little Way shows us that every moment of every day offers opportunities for sanctity.
days.intention_prayer: St. Therese, help me to see opportunities for love in the small things of daily life. Teach me to do everything with great love for God.
days.scripture: "Whoever is faithful in very little is also faithful in much." - Luke 16:10

days.title: Day 4: Offering Suffering with Love
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: St. Therese, during your short life you experienced much suffering - illness, misunderstandings, spiritual dryness, and finally tuberculosis. Yet you embraced all your sufferings with love, offering them to God for the salvation of souls. You understood that suffering becomes redemptive when it is united with the sufferings of Christ. I come to you today with my own sufferings [mention specific sufferings or difficulties]. Help me to see them as you did - not as meaningless pain but as opportunities to share in Christ's passion and to help in the work of salvation. When I am in physical pain, emotional distress, or spiritual darkness, help me to remember that these sufferings can become prayers when offered with love. Teach me not to waste my suffering by complaining or becoming bitter, but to transform it into love by uniting it with Jesus on the cross. Help me to understand that sometimes the greatest gift I can give to God and to others is to bear my sufferings with patience, joy, and trust. Give me the grace to say with you: 'I will spend my heaven doing good on earth.' St. Therese, help me to suffer as you did, with love and for love. Amen.
days.closing_prayer: St. Therese, Little Flower of Jesus, pray for us.
days.reflection: St. Therese transformed her sufferings into powerful intercessions for others. She shows us that when we offer our pain with love, it becomes a participation in Christ's redemptive work and a source of grace for the world.
days.intention_prayer: St. Therese, help me to unite my sufferings with those of Jesus. Teach me to find meaning and purpose in my difficulties by offering them for others.
days.scripture: "I fill up in my flesh what is still lacking in regard to Christ's afflictions, for the sake of his body, which is the church." - Colossians 1:24

days.title: Day 5: Missionary Spirit
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: St. Therese, although you never left your cloistered convent, you had the heart of a missionary. You adopted spiritual brothers who were priests working in far-off lands, and you supported them with your prayers and sacrifices. You understood that we can all be missionaries by offering our lives for the salvation of souls. Help me to have your missionary spirit, even if I never travel to distant countries. Show me how I can be a missionary in my own family, neighborhood, workplace, and community. Help me to pray for missionaries, priests, and all who work to spread the Gospel. Teach me to offer my daily actions and sacrifices for the conversion of sinners and the salvation of souls. Give me a heart that cares about people I have never met and will never see, knowing that we are all connected in the Body of Christ. Help me to be patient with those who don't share my faith, and show me how to witness to God's love through my actions more than my words. Inspire me to support missionary work through my prayers, sacrifices, and material contributions when possible. St. Therese, patron of missionaries, make me a missionary of love wherever I am. Amen.
days.closing_prayer: St. Therese, Little Flower of Jesus, pray for us.
days.reflection: St. Therese proves that we can have a global impact through prayer and sacrifice, even if we never leave home. Her missionary spirit reminds us that every soul matters to God and that we can all participate in the work of evangelization.
days.intention_prayer: St. Therese, give me your missionary heart. Help me to care about the salvation of souls and to offer my life for the spread of the Gospel.
days.scripture: "Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit." - Matthew 28:19

days.title: Day 6: Family Love and Healing
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: St. Therese, you came from a loving family that nurtured your faith and supported your vocation. Your parents, Louis and Zelie Martin, are now saints themselves, and your sisters shared your religious calling. You understood the importance of family love and the pain that comes when families are divided or broken. I pray today for my family and for all families. Where there is love, help it to grow stronger. Where there is misunderstanding, bring clarity and patience. Where there has been hurt, bring healing and forgiveness. Help family members to support each other's faith journey and to respect each other's choices, even when they differ. Bless parents with wisdom to guide their children, and help children to honor and appreciate their parents. For families experiencing separation, divorce, or estrangement, bring opportunities for reconciliation and peace. Protect families from the forces that would divide them, and help them to make their homes places of love, faith, and joy. I especially pray for [mention specific family intentions]. St. Therese, who knew the blessing of a holy family, intercede for all families that they may reflect the love of the Holy Family of Jesus, Mary, and Joseph. Amen.
days.closing_prayer: St. Therese, Little Flower of Jesus, pray for us.
days.reflection: St. Therese's family background shows us how important it is for families to support each other in faith. Her prayers can help heal wounded families and strengthen the bonds of love that God intends for family life.
days.intention_prayer: St. Therese, pray for my family and all families. Help us to love and support each other as your family did.
days.scripture: "As for me and my household, we will serve the Lord." - Joshua 24:15

days.title: Day 7: Simplicity and Humility
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: St. Therese, you embraced simplicity in all things - in your prayer, your lifestyle, your relationships, and your approach to God. You were not impressed by complicated spiritual practices or extraordinary mystical experiences, but found God in the ordinary and simple. Help me to embrace simplicity as you did. In a world that often values complexity, competition, and achievement, teach me to appreciate the simple gifts of life: a beautiful day, a kind word, a moment of peace, a loving gesture. Help me to resist the temptation to make my spiritual life complicated. Show me how to pray simply, love simply, and trust simply. Free me from the pride that wants to appear sophisticated or impressive, and help me to be genuine and honest in all my relationships. Teach me to be humble like you were, never thinking myself better than others but always ready to serve and to learn. Help me to find joy in being unknown and unnoticed when that is God's will for me. Show me how to be content with small things and to find richness in simplicity. St. Therese, little flower in God's garden, help me to bloom simply and beautifully where God has planted me. Amen.
days.closing_prayer: St. Therese, Little Flower of Jesus, pray for us.
days.reflection: St. Therese's simplicity was not simplistic but profound. She understood that the deepest truths are often the simplest ones, and that God is found more easily by those who approach Him with humble, uncomplicated hearts.
days.intention_prayer: St. Therese, teach me to embrace simplicity and humility. Help me to find God in the ordinary moments of life.
days.scripture: "At that time Jesus said, 'I praise you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because you have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children.'" - Matthew 11:25

days.title: Day 8: Shower of Roses
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: St. Therese, before your death you promised to 'let fall a shower of roses' from heaven, and countless people have experienced the truth of this promise through signs, favors, and answers to prayer. You continue to keep your word, sending roses - both real flowers and spiritual graces - to those who call upon you with faith. I ask you today to shower me with your roses. Send me signs of God's love and care, especially when I feel discouraged or forgotten. Help me to recognize the roses you send - they might come as unexpected kindness from others, as moments of peace in difficult times, as solutions to problems, or as actual roses that appear in surprising ways. But more than external signs, I ask for the spiritual roses of grace: the rose of peace when I am anxious, the rose of joy when I am sad, the rose of hope when I despair, the rose of love when my heart grows cold. Help me to be a rose for others too - bringing beauty, fragrance, and joy into their lives through my words and actions. Teach me to spread your roses by sharing your Little Way with others and by being a source of comfort and encouragement. St. Therese, my Little Flower, let fall upon me and all who pray this novena a shower of roses from heaven. Amen.
days.closing_prayer: St. Therese, Little Flower of Jesus, pray for us.
days.reflection: St. Therese's promise of roses represents her ongoing care for us from heaven. These roses remind us that the saints are not distant figures but active intercessors who continue to help us in very real and personal ways.
days.intention_prayer: St. Therese, send me your roses as signs of hope and love. Help me to recognize God's care in the signs and graces you send.
days.scripture: "I am the rose of Sharon, and the lily of the valleys." - Song of Songs 2:1

days.title: Day 9: Doing Good on Earth
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: St. Therese, you promised that you would 'spend your heaven doing good on earth,' and you have kept that promise magnificently. From your place in glory, you continue to help, guide, comfort, and intercede for those who call upon you. As I conclude this novena, I thank you for all the ways you have already helped me, even when I wasn't aware of your intercession. I ask you to continue watching over me throughout my life. Help me to live faithfully according to your Little Way, trusting in God's love, doing small things with great love, and offering all my joys and sorrows for the salvation of souls. When my time comes to leave this earth, be with me as you have been with so many others, helping me to die peacefully and trustingly in God's arms. And if it is God's will, help me to join you in heaven where I can thank you personally for all your kindness. Until then, continue your good work on earth through your intercession for me and for all who need your help. I promise to honor you always as my special patron and to encourage others to discover your Little Way of trust and love. St. Therese, faithful friend and powerful intercessor, continue to do good on earth until Christ comes again in glory. Amen.
days.closing_prayer: St. Therese, Little Flower of Jesus, pray for us.
days.reflection: St. Therese's promise to continue doing good on earth reminds us that death is not the end but a transformation. The communion of saints is real, and those who have gone before us continue to care for us and help us on our journey to heaven.
days.intention_prayer: St. Therese, thank you for your continued intercession. Help me to live faithfully and to reach heaven where I can thank you in person.
days.scripture: "Therefore, since we are surrounded by such a great cloud of witnesses, let us throw off everything that hinders and the sin that so easily entangles." - Hebrews 12:1

source: Traditional Catholic Novena to St. Therese of Lisieux
notes: This novena can be prayed at any time, but is especially meaningful around her feast day (October 1) or when seeking her intercession for family matters, simplicity in spiritual life, or trust in God's love. Many people report receiving roses (flowers or the scent of roses) as signs that St. Therese has heard their prayers. Her 'Little Way' continues to inspire people of all ages to find holiness in ordinary life through extraordinary love.
